script.base: Closing line is PHI -6, total 43.5, implied PHI 24.8 / WAS 18.8, so the book has Philadelphia leading by about a score in a middling outdoor game, not a shootout. script.flip1: PHI gets up big early, runs the clock, Barkley carries rise while Devonta Smith, Marquise Brown, Dallas Goedert and Zach Ertz yards stall, and WAS fully abandons the run so White and Jacory Croskey-Merritt rush lines die while garbage-time throws prop up WAS receivers.
script.flip2: WAS hangs around or the game turns into a pass-first track meet: PHI never gets the clock-kill script, Barkley carries compress toward his recent floor, and WAS keeps a real rush share so a dog-abandon-run read fails.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and Barkley under 60.5 lost. Week 1, Bigsby took the change-of-pace and goal-line work, WAS loaded the box because the -6 script was obvious, and PHI threw to Smith, Brown and Goedert, so Barkley finished in the 40s on limited carries. The 2025 last4 may not be this offense's 2026 usage, outdoor weather was never saved, and with no no-vig we may have been on the expensive side of a number the market already set at a workhorse 60.5. That counter is real but not stronger than a lead-script plus a 68-yard recent floor, so the leg stays a lean and is flagged, not cut.
